subject: Conductor 0.87.6 Contents/Resources/bin and how its frontend runs those tools

source.bundle_manifest: evidence/scripts/MANIFEST.md (sha256 of every file in Conductor.app/Contents/Resources)
source.frontend: Conductor's embedded frontend, extracted from the Tauri asset table (REA gap 1, tools/extract_tauri_assets.py), file assets/index-BGEQ8YjU.js, read on sven m5 max 2026-11-05
source.trust: quoted code is untrusted third-party data

frontend_paths.app_bin_dir: Vl() = join(await appData(), "bin"); appData() = plugin:path|resolve_directory {directory: AppData}
frontend_paths.gh: za({host}) = remote host ? "/conductor/bin/gh" : join(Vl(), "gh"); used for gh pr list, the git credential helper on push, branch-rename PR lookups (10 call sites)
frontend_paths.agents: Claude and Codex auth checks use `${Vl()}/claude` as the default executable; ACP providers live in appData/agent-binaries/acp-providers
frontend_paths.conductor-skill: only the remote path /conductor/worker/conductor-skill/skills/conductor/SKILL.md appears in the frontend

inference: The frontend only reads appData/bin, while the files ship in Resources/bin, so Conductor's Rust side copies Resources/bin into appData/bin; the copy code is not in the frontend and was not located in the binary.

bundled.bin/gh: scripts/fetch-bundled-tools.sh (pinned, both hashes checked) + src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json; installed into $APPDATA/bin at startup by src-tauri/src/bundled_bin.rs; every gh caller resolves $OPENCONDUCTOR_GH, then $APPDATA/bin/gh, then PATH
bundled.bin/checkpointer.sh: src-tauri/resources/bin-tools/checkpointer.sh: shim that execs the app binary in tool mode (`openconductor --tool checkpointer`, src-tauri/src/tool_cli.rs) over the native src-tauri/src/checkpoint; same command line, output and exit codes (0/1/101/102/103) as Conductor's script
bundled.bin/git-busy-check.sh: src-tauri/resources/bin-tools/git-busy-check.sh: shim into `openconductor --tool git-busy-check` (checkpoint/busy.rs); prints clean | busy:<kind>, exit 2 for a bad path or non-repo
bundled.bin/.internal/openconductor: symlink to the running app binary, written into $APPDATA/bin at startup by bundled_bin::link_exe; the shims exec it, as Conductor's shims exec bin/.internal/conductor-runtime

not_bundled.bin/watchexec: spotlight watches natively (src-tauri/src/spotlight/watch.rs); Conductor's build also differs from the upstream release
not_bundled.bin/conductor, bin/.internal/*: shims that exec conductor-runtime, Conductor's Bun-compiled agent runtime; no OpenConductor counterpart yet
not_bundled.conductor-skill/: agent-facing skill; belongs with the agent runtime
